Nvidia Reinstates CEO Jensen Huang Amid Espionage Allegations

Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, effective immediately, reversing a decision made on November 12 following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for China. The company stated that senior levels of the United States government provided input, and based on this, the board is confident that Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk. US President Donald Trump welcomed the move, calling Huang a "Great Patriot And National Treasure." Elon Musk also voiced support for the decision. Nvidia shares surged as much as 33% following the reinstatement, lifting the company's market value toward $3.91 trillion, though its stock remained down about 20% for November. An independent committee is continuing an investigation into the alleged foreign intelligence operation and alleged extramarital affairs.
